notes.title: Major Update 2.01
notes.content:
This update includes the following...

New weather effects and lighting.
New sub-enemy type.
New and improved suit voice.
Improvements to enemy hit animations.
Improvements to many weapon effects.
Improvements to enemy AI.
Improvements to enemy vehicle AI.
Many weapons work more predictably and reliably.

tags.balance_change: Many weapons work more predictably and reliably.

notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.content:
More dismemberment!  It is now easier to dismember your robot foes, Use the T-Beam to hold enemies in place as you shoot of their limbs or punch an enemies head clean off!

The intro mission has also been improved with a new environment and more enemies.

There have also been many other minor bug fixes and gameplay refinements to make combat more satisfying!

notes.title: Major Update 1.01
notes.content:
This major update changes the structure of recordance to a mission based system. 
Missions and challenges include wave survival, races, elimination, time trials and more.
14 missions are currently available with more to come soon!

This update also includes the addition of leaderboards which are currently in the experimental stage, a new central hub level, performance and graphical tweaks as well as additional graphics options.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.01
notes.content: This patch maps the pause menu to the esc key as well as P. It also contains tweaks to mouse sensitivity settings and better signposting to missions in the Central hub level.
